scope: SAP Sales monitoring and process analytics evidence used by the Lab KPI model
policy: SAP sources prove available product analytics concepts and terminology. The Lab KPI formulas, governance rules, diagnostic links and target policies are independently authored and are not presented as SAP standard KPI definitions unless a source explicitly says so.

sources.title: Sales Monitoring and Analytics
sources.evidence_role: Supports the use of sales KPIs and drill-down analysis across quotations, orders, fulfillment and invoices, including incoming orders, back orders, delivery performance and sales volume.

sources.title: Incoming Sales Orders - Flexible Analysis
sources.evidence_role: Supports incoming-order value, quantity, item-count and confirmed-quantity analytics with dimensional drill-down.

sources.title: Sales Order Fulfillment - Analyze and Resolve Issues
sources.evidence_role: Supports issue-oriented fulfillment analytics using transactional and analytical views, including blocks, missing documents and missing or unconfirmed information.

sources.title: Configuration Settings: Sales Order Fulfillment
sources.evidence_role: Documents the Sales Order Fulfillment Issues KPI and its minimizing goal type.

sources.title: Customizable Metrics
sources.evidence_role: Supports duration, percentage, amount and aggregation metrics for process analysis and benchmarking.

sources.title: Process Flows and Performance Indicators
sources.evidence_role: Supports operational performance analysis using automation, backlog, exception and process-progress indicators.

sources.title: Cycle Time
sources.evidence_role: Supports explicit start-event and end-event definitions for cycle-time metrics.
